walkthroughs.body_html:
Literature (Two Works Studied) — a core area of German.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Literature (Two Works Studied) brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Literature (Two Works Studied).
